name: mach-composable
_readme: Vendor-neutral reference on MACH and composable commerce: what each principle demands of the client organisation, the recurring composable patterns and when each fits, the cases where composable is the wrong answer, the cost and operating-model consequences, and a decision checklist. Hand-written from delivery practice, not from a vendor document; every statement is reference guidance to be confirmed against the client's team, operating model and integration budget.

snippets.reference_persona: architect who has both delivered and un-delivered composable programmes and therefore prices the operating model and the integration budget before the architecture
snippets.reference_focus: whether the MACH claim survives contact with the client's team size, operating model and integration budget; which capability is actually being decomposed and why that capability is the constraint; whether the client can run N vendors' upgrade cycles and on-call load; whether the real problem is data ownership rather than the platform
